name: Data Minimization
description: Limit the collection of personal data to what is adequate, relevant, and reasonably necessary in relation to the disclosed purposes.

name: Purpose Limitation
description: Do not process personal data for purposes neither reasonably necessary to nor compatible with the disclosed purposes without the consumer's consent.

name: Data Security Practices
description: Establish, implement, and maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical data security practices appropriate to the volume and nature of the personal data.

name: Non-Discrimination
description: Do not process personal data in violation of anti-discrimination laws and do not discriminate against a consumer for exercising consumer rights.

name: Consent Mechanism
description: Obtain the consumer's consent before processing sensitive data, or comply with COPPA for a known child.

name: Prohibition on Sale of Precise Geolocation Data
description: Do not sell or offer for sale precise geolocation data concerning a consumer.

name: Privacy Notice
description: Provide a reasonably accessible, clear, and meaningful privacy notice containing the elements enumerated in the statute.

name: Opt-Out Disclosure
description: Clearly and conspicuously disclose sale of personal data and targeted advertising processing and the manner of exercising the right to opt out.

name: Consumer Request Mechanism
description: Establish and describe in a privacy notice one or more secure and reliable means for consumers to submit rights requests, without requiring a new account.

name: Authentication
description: Authenticate consumer requests using commercially reasonable efforts; where authentication fails, the controller need not comply and may request additional information.

name: Appeal Process
description: Establish a conspicuously available appeal process and respond in writing within 60 days, providing a method to contact the Attorney General if denied.

name: Processor Contract
description: Execute a binding contract governing the processor's data processing procedures containing the required statutory terms.

name: Data Protection Assessment Documentation
description: Conduct and document data protection assessments weighing benefits against risks as mitigated by safeguards.

name: De-identification Safeguards
description: Take reasonable measures to ensure de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural person, publicly commit not to re-identify, and contractually obligate recipients.
